adaptations.behavior: misparented table-internal boxes generate the required anonymous table wrapper, row group, row, and cell boxes
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: the immutable box-tree kinds and source identities are asserted before layout

adaptations.behavior: anonymous table rows and cells remain nested under their owning row group
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: the structural box-tree relationship replaces graphical reference comparison

adaptations.behavior: hostile colspan and row-span attributes are normalized to bounded HTML table metadata
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: bounded metadata is inspected without allocating a dense slot matrix

adaptations.behavior: rowspan zero extends through the remainder of the current row group
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: the slot intervals and used cell rectangle are asserted

adaptations.behavior: column and cell spans grow the immutable table slot grid before sizing
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: resolved column boundaries are compared in fixed-point CSS pixels

adaptations.behavior: single-column cells contribute minimum and preferred intrinsic column measures
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: the shared text measurer supplies CSS-pixel intrinsic contributions

adaptations.behavior: spanning-cell deficits are planned by span group and applied independently of cell traversal order
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: column measures are asserted before terminal cell snapping

adaptations.behavior: automatic table layout computes min-content, max-content, and shrink-to-fit table widths
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: used table and column widths are compared in CSS pixels

adaptations.behavior: fixed table layout derives column widths from columns and applicable first-row cells
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: later-row text overflow is retained in layout fragments rather than graphical pixels

adaptations.behavior: fixed-layout excess width is distributed only after constrained columns are resolved
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: fixed-point column rectangles expose the distribution

adaptations.behavior: cell minimum and maximum width constraints participate in automatic column measures
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: constraints are inspected as used CSS values

adaptations.behavior: non-rowspanning cells establish row minimum block sizes after final column widths are known
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: wrapped line boxes determine CSS-pixel row heights

adaptations.behavior: rowspan block-size deficits are distributed across eligible rows by increasing span
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: used row boundaries are asserted before rasterization

adaptations.behavior: baseline-aligned cells share a row baseline while empty cells retain valid geometry
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: layout-fragment baselines and child offsets replace pixel comparison

adaptations.behavior: cell descendants resolve percentage block sizes only after the cell containing block becomes definite
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: the cell is relaid out against the final row span height

adaptations.behavior: top and bottom captions remain outside the table root border box and inside the table wrapper, whose minimum inline size includes caption contributions
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: caption and table rectangles are compared in fixed-point CSS pixels

adaptations.behavior: separated border spacing contributes around the grid edge and between active tracks
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: spacing is measured before terminal snapping

adaptations.behavior: authored table-cell margins do not participate in used table geometry or overflow
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: the cell margin and border rectangles are compared in fixed-point CSS pixels

adaptations.behavior: empty-cells has a typed computed value and suppresses separated empty-cell background and border painting
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: absence of table paint commands is asserted

adaptations.behavior: collapsed borders resolve hidden, none, width, origin, and source-order precedence
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: one winning terminal border command is retained per used edge segment

adaptations.behavior: collapsed borders crossing mismatched cell spans are split into nonoverlapping slot-edge segments
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: paint-command identities replace graphical corner comparison

adaptations.behavior: table, column-group, column, row-group, row, and cell backgrounds retain table paint order
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: display-list command order is asserted directly

adaptations.behavior: collapsed rows and columns remove their breadth without retaining duplicate border spacing
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: surviving cell rectangles are compared in CSS pixels

adaptations.behavior: absolute descendants remain outside table row and column sizing and use their final table containing block
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: normal-flow table geometry and positioned fragment geometry are inspected separately

adaptations.behavior: RTL horizontal table flow reverses physical columns without reversing logical source order
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: column geometry and logical search order are asserted independently

adaptations.behavior: table, rowgroup, row, cell, columnheader, rowheader, caption name, and headers/scope relationships derive from document semantics rather than painted text
adaptations.terminalAdjustment: header document-node identities and terminal accessibility bounds are both asserted
